sections.indications_and_usage: Uses Temporarily relieves cough due to minor throat and bronchial irritation and nasal congestion as may occur with the common cold or inhaled irritants
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions Adults and children 12 years of age and over: take 2 teaspoons (10 mL) every 4 hours. Do not exceed 6 doses in 24 hours. Children under 12 years of age: consult a doctor.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Do not exceed recommended dosage. If nervousness, dizziness, or sleepiness occur, discontinue use and consult a doctor. A persistent cough may be a sign of a serious condition. If cough persists more than one week, tends to recur, or is accompanied by fever, rash, or persistent headache, consult a doctor.
